DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname for external database mode

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of PostgreSQL database if using external DB. Default: keycloak

PG_USERNAME.description: PostgreSQL username with access to Keycloak schema

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode for SSL termination. Valid: edge|reencrypt|passthrough

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname used in generated URIs and redirects

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
